title: Steel plate smelted at our outpost GSC-0044 from the faction's iron ore there (withdraw from: faction), put back into the faction's storage (Logistics' haulers)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 06:24 UTC (orders ENT-085 block APOLLO: 'the officer stands: write the steel route on the outpost's faction iron (withdraw, from: faction)'). The faction's storage at the outpost holds 100,000 iron ore (tool stock 06:05 UTC). status off: a withdraw from the faction's storage needs manage_treasury, and no hauler's role carries it: spacemolt_faction info read this turn from a hauler: Leader and Officer have it, Builder (the one hauler with a role) and Member do not (requests.log, this turn, to Unity). Also untested: a hand recipe at an outpost (no personal storage, craft from the hold). On when a role with manage_treasury stands on haulers: one ship first, one run, its RESULT line read. Each run: the hold filled with faction iron (keep 0), basic_iron_smelting in halving sizes from the hold, the plates and what is left stored back into the faction's storage. 2026-11-24 10:03 UTC (Apollo): on by Unity's answer requests.log ENT-500 and ENT-505: requires.role officer (the dispatcher sends it only to an Officer, empire.json; Officers hold manage_treasury); one ship, one run first, its RESULT line read before any lift (rule F37). 2026-11-24 12:27 UTC (Apollo): off. 26 runs from 10:08 UTC noted 'faction withdraw iron_ore: refused' and made nothing (runs.jsonl). A one-unit hand test from an Officer docked at the outpost (12:27 UTC) read the game's answer: 'no_storage: This station does not offer storage', with target self and with no target; the help of storage says a faction withdraw goes to target self, the pilot's personal storage, which an outpost has not. So the faction's iron at an outpost cannot reach a hold. Back on only by a way the game offers (a production facility there that draws on the faction's storage, untested).
